title: Claim you're a REAL Disney fan? Test your knowledge with 50 hard questions | Disney Quiz #10
description_hook: 🏰 Put your Disney knowledge to the test with 50 hard questions that'll sort the superfans from the casual viewers.

questions.question: Before Mickey Mouse, what was Walt Disney's first big cartoon star?
questions.reveal: Walt lost the rights to Oswald in 1928, so he created a mouse instead.

questions.question: In which 1928 cartoon did Mickey Mouse make his debut with synchronised sound?
questions.reveal: Mickey whistles at the wheel of a riverboat, and an icon was born.

questions.question: In which year was Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs released?
questions.reveal: It was the first full-length cel-animated feature film.

questions.question: What are the names of Ursula's two eels in The Little Mermaid?
questions.reveal: Named after the bits of a shipwreck floating on the sea.

questions.question: What does Ariel call a fork in The Little Mermaid?
questions.reveal: Scuttle insists humans use it to straighten their hair.

questions.question: What is the name of Mulan's horse?
questions.reveal: Khan is the Mongolian word for ruler.

questions.question: What are the names of the three hyenas in The Lion King?
questions.reveal: Ed only laughs. He never says a single word.

questions.question: In Aladdin, what is the name of Princess Jasmine's tiger?
questions.reveal: Rajah means king in Sanskrit and Hindi.

questions.question: What name does Aurora go by while hiding in the forest in Sleeping Beauty?
questions.reveal: The three good fairies raised her in a woodcutter's cottage.

questions.question: What are the names of Cinderella's two stepsisters?
questions.reveal: Drizella wears green and Anastasia wears pink.

questions.question: In 101 Dalmatians, what is the name of Pongo's partner?
questions.reveal: Together they have 15 puppies of their own.

questions.question: What kind of animal is King Louie in The Jungle Book (1967)?
questions.reveal: He doesn't appear in Rudyard Kipling's original book at all.

questions.question: What is Stitch's experiment number in Lilo & Stitch?
questions.reveal: Stitch was designed by Dr Jumba to destroy everything he touches.

questions.question: In Tangled, what is the name of Rapunzel's chameleon?
questions.reveal: Pascal changes colour to show how he's feeling.

questions.question: What is the name of the kingdom in Frozen?
questions.reveal: Its look was inspired by Norway's fjords.

questions.question: What is the name of Moana's pet pig?
questions.reveal: Heihei the rooster gets the adventure; Pua stays home.

questions.question: In Raya and the Last Dragon, what is the name of the last dragon?
questions.reveal: Sisu can borrow abilities from her dragon siblings.

questions.question: In Encanto, what is the family's surname?
questions.reveal: Everyone gets a magic gift except Mirabel.

questions.question: What was the first fully computer-animated feature film?
questions.reveal: Released in 1995, it took Pixar about four years to make.

questions.question: What is the name of the boy who tortures toys in Toy Story?
questions.reveal: Sid Phillips later shows up as a rubbish collector in Toy Story 3.

questions.question: In Finding Nemo, what address does Dory keep reading?
questions.reveal: It's the Sydney dentist's office where Nemo ends up in a fish tank.

questions.question: In Up, what is the name of the talking dog?
questions.reveal: Squirrel!

questions.question: What is Sulley's full name in Monsters, Inc.?
questions.reveal: He has more than two million individually animated hairs.

questions.question: In The Incredibles, what is the name of the superhero costume designer?
questions.reveal: Her number one rule: NO CAPES!

questions.question: In Ratatouille, which famous chef's motto is 'Anyone can cook'?
questions.reveal: Remy learns everything from Gusteau's cookbook.

questions.question: In WALL-E, what is the name of the robot WALL-E falls for?
questions.reveal: EVE stands for Extraterrestrial Vegetation Evaluator.

questions.question: What is Lightning McQueen's racing number in Cars?
questions.reveal: A nod to 1995, the year Toy Story came out.

questions.question: In Coco, what is the name of Miguel's dog?
questions.reveal: He's a Xoloitzcuintli, the national dog of Mexico.

questions.question: In Zootopia, what is the name of the sloth at the DMV?
questions.reveal: Flash, Flash, Hundred-Yard Dash. Not exactly speedy.

questions.question: In Big Hero 6, what is the name of the city?
questions.reveal: A mash-up of San Francisco and Tokyo.

questions.question: In Wreck-It Ralph, which racing game is Vanellope from?
questions.reveal: Every kart in it is made of sweets.

questions.question: In The Princess and the Frog, what is the name of the trumpet-playing alligator?
questions.reveal: He dreams of playing jazz with the big bands.

questions.question: In Brave, what does Merida's mother turn into?
questions.reveal: All because of a spell from a woodcarver witch.

questions.question: Which was the first animated film nominated for the Best Picture Oscar?
questions.reveal: It was nominated in 1992, but The Silence of the Lambs won.

questions.question: In Hercules, what are the names of Hades' two sidekicks?
questions.reveal: Pain is pink and short; Panic is blue and tall.

questions.question: What are the names of the three gargoyles in The Hunchback of Notre Dame?
questions.reveal: Victor and Hugo are named after the novel's author, Victor Hugo.

questions.question: In Pocahontas, what is the name of the raccoon?
questions.reveal: Meeko is always stealing biscuits.

questions.question: In Peter Pan, what kind of animal is Nana, the Darlings' nanny?
questions.reveal: She's a Saint Bernard in the 1953 film.

questions.question: In Bambi, what is the name of the skunk?
questions.reveal: Bambi accidentally names him while learning the word for flower.

questions.question: In Dumbo, what kind of animal is Timothy?
questions.reveal: Fitting, since elephants are supposedly scared of mice.

questions.question: What are the names of Donald Duck's three nephews?
questions.reveal: In the old cartoons, their caps were red, blue and green.

questions.question: What is the name of Goofy's son?
questions.reveal: He starred in A Goofy Movie in 1995.

questions.question: In Alice in Wonderland (1951), what do the Mad Hatter and March Hare celebrate?
questions.reveal: With 364 unbirthdays a year, there's plenty of cake.

questions.question: In Aladdin, what is the name of Jafar's parrot?
questions.reveal: Named after the scheming villain in Shakespeare's Othello.

questions.question: In Beauty and the Beast, what kind of object is Lumière?
questions.reveal: He's a French maître d' turned into candlesticks.

questions.question: What is the name of the evil fairy in Sleeping Beauty?
questions.reveal: She's furious she wasn't invited to the christening.

questions.question: Which Disney film features the song 'The Bare Necessities'?
questions.reveal: Baloo sings it while floating down the river with Mowgli.

questions.question: What is the name of Mulan's dragon guardian?
questions.reveal: He was demoted to gong-ringer before his big mission.

questions.question: In Inside Out, which emotion has blue skin and glasses?
questions.reveal: And she turns out to be the key to the whole film.

questions.question: In Toy Story, what is the name of the pizza restaurant?
questions.reveal: Its delivery truck shows up in almost every Pixar film.

questions.note: Giulia, 6 Nov 2026: no approval stops; fully automated. Fact-checked by Claude when written.
